messages:
satish: heads up — saw a customer on staging get another workspace's saved filters in Insights for ~3s when they rapidly switched tabs :eyes:
elaine: ugh. any repro steps? last happened on which build?
jon: could be cache key collapse. I just repro'd — if the request goes through the edge and X-Workspace-ID header is dropped, the edge cache returns a previously cached snapshot for a different workspace.
satish: repro steps I used: login as workspace-A, open Insights, switch to workspace-B via quick-switch, click saved-filters. sometimes results show A's filters for a split second. here's the console trace + network: https://staging.gifs/repro-123 (screenshare)
jon: grabbing curl:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Requested-With: Console" "https://edge.redwood-inference.internal/insights/saved-filters" \
  --compressed
# noticed that when the request hits internal-proxy the forwarded headers are:
# X-Request-ID: abc
# X-Requested-With: Console
# (missing X-Workspace-ID) -> fallback to cache key = "insights:global:v1"
```
carla: that explains it. edge cache uses a single key when workspace header absent, so rapid switch + stale snapshot = visual bleed. not a DB or auth leak, still bad UX/PII risk if filters include names.
elaine: do we have telemetry to find how many times this happened in prod? can we query logs for backend responses that served cache_hit=true but had workspace mismatch?
jon: yes — we log response.cache_key and request.workspace_id (if present). sample kql: `logs | where response.cache_hit == true and response.cache_key !contains request.workspace_id` — should find mismatches. I'll run it for last 72h.
satish: ok run it, and also add a quick alert for >0 matches for prod to be safe.
deploy-bot: scheduled job "cache-key-mismatch-audit" started (run_id: 2026-03-20-01)
jon: quick findings: ~14 mismatches in the last 24h, mostly during console release window 02:00-04:00 UTC. looks correlated with traffic from our mobile web NF routing path that strips custom headers.
carla: mitigation options: 1) add workspace id to cache key unconditionally (best) 2) set Cache-Control: private for endpoints that return per-workspace snapshots 3) ensure edge sets Vary: X-Workspace-ID so caches are segmented
elaine: patch preference? we need minimal blast radius for rollout.
carla: propose option 3 first (Vary) + retroactive purge of impacted cache keys, then option 1 in a follow-up to be safe. Vary change is low-risk and can be canaried.
satish: I'll own the canary. plan: patch edge-router config to include `Vary: X-Workspace-ID` for insights endpoints -> roll to 10% -> monitor mismatch-alerts and UX repro -> if green roll to 100% -> then follow-up to bake workspace into cache key and remove Vary when done.
jon: also add a unit test in internal-proxy to assert forwarded headers include X-Workspace-ID for console-originated requests.
elaine: good. carla, can you open a short RFC so infra and mobile teams are aware (header loss on NF path)?
carla: opening RFC: https://go/redwood/rfc/edge-workspace-vary-2026 — will tag mobile-team and infra-team.
satish: deploy-bot, start canary deploy to staging 10% for edge-router with Vary header change.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: edge-router:v2.14.1 -> 10% traffic routing (canary id c-20260320-11)
elaine: I'll wire up the alert: metric "cache_workspace_mismatch_count" > 0 -> pager to eng-platform on-call. start with only slack alert for 10% then page if >5 in 15m.
jon: fyi we should also scan the audit logs to ensure no persisted objects (saved-filters) were written cross-workspace. quick grep shows no write operations with mismatched workspace ids. read-only leak only.
carla: thanks. after canary, if mismatch drops to 0, we'll purge the small set of impacted keys and ship the cache-key change in next release.
satish: I'll post the post-mortem once we confirm purge and key change timeline. for now, prioritizing UX fix + telemetry alert. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks all — good catch.
jon: assigning a follow-up task: ENG-PLAT-5873 (add header-forwarding test + telemetry dashboard).
carla: tagging mobile infra: @mobile-team @edge-infra — please confirm why NF strip happens on some routes.
satish: closing loop: if anyone finds other endpoints with similar behavior file a ticket under ENG-PLAT-ISOLATION.
